description: Minimal permissions for the 0xgen desktop shell's main window. Grants only the plugin commands the frontend actually calls: reading/saving files through native dialogs, reading OS platform/arch for the About screen, and opening release links on github.com/RowanDark/0xgen in the system browser. Custom #[tauri::command] app commands are not part of the ACL system (no app-level permission manifest is registered) and remain reachable from the bundled frontend as usual.
